title: The Recompose
one_liner: The frame rearranges itself around every sentence: your face, then a split with the thing you mean, then the real proof full screen, then back to you.
best_for: Explainers with a point per sentence: 'here's why', how a tool works, a list of reasons, anything where you can show the real page or the real thing you mention.
effort: Medium: one 15-30 s take plus 2-4 real screenshots or logos. Claude builds it; in Edits you add one overlay and keyframe your clip between two positions.

palette.use: paper field behind proof and split beats
pale sage field for type and equation slides
brand accent (default #FF5A36, yours goes here): italic words, highlighter, ticks, keyword in captions
pale tint of your accent (mixed automatically) behind hook line 2
cards, hook line 1, captions over your footage

pace: The layout changes about every 2.4 s (8 frame states + 2 object carries in 23.7 s, each a 0.5 s eased recompose, never a hard cut), with something landing inside each beat about every 1.5 s; voice at 1.1x, no music.
signature_moves: One frame, three states: face -> split (you in a rounded box, the object above) -> full-screen proof, with no hard cuts, it recomposes
Real proof grows from the split into full screen while a highlighter sweeps the exact words you say
Serif-italic accent words and a visual equation (idea x tool = result) built from the objects already on screen
